review_notes:
I read the whole file and looked at its definitions: ordIdeal, wmap, InI, PInI, linMap, XPt, inlPt, inrPt, cwPt, GPt, wX, wOf, phiSeries, phiPt, phiHom, truncFam and truncPt. I searched Mathlib's MvPowerSeries directory for an ideal of series with order at least n. The closest matches are LinearTopology.basis, which is indexed by a two-sided ideal of coefficients plus an exponent bound and is a different concept, and hasSubstIdeal/hasEvalIdeal, which are ideals of families and unrelated. I found no Mathlib declaration for ordIdeal, for the Witt-vector quotient map wmap (which just wraps WittVector.map), or for truncFam (a killCompl substitution family along Fin.valEmbedding).

The same ordIdeal, wmap, linMap, XPt, inlPt and truncFam definitions are repeated across several sibling files under P2M/Sol/. Each copy sits in its own namespace and none appears in the imported Definitions or Theorems files. That is cross-file copying inside the project, not a competing version of a Mathlib concept, so I did not report it. The iterate_map_add and iterate_map_sum lemmas are standalone theorems, which the rubric excludes. The only residual uncertainty is that I did not exhaustively search every Mathlib file for order-ideal notions on MvPowerSeries.
